messages:
Priya (AE): handing off Northbridge Labs - contract signed, pilot starts Mon. Quick context: data residency EU, expect bursty usage for lab analysis, 3 teams (research, ops, compliance). They requested VPC and bring-your-own-KMS. Renewal: 11 months.
Lila (CSM): taking lead. main ask: who owns KMS setup + compliance checklist?
Priya (AE): legal wants us to document data flow. Customer to send SOC/ISO contacts. On KMS: customer ops will manage key in their account but we need ARN + rotation policy.
Ben (CS Ops): I'll own KMS integration. Can someone confirm if we need custom peering or can use transit gateway? Also need expected egress rules.
Ravi (Support Eng): pinging eng-infra to confirm peering options. I'll open ticket.
onboard-bot: Welcome packet sent to contacts: alan@northbridge.example, mel@northbridge.example
Lila (CSM): owners: CSM=Lila, CS Ops=Ben, Eng Support=Ravi, AE=Priya. Next steps: 1) customer to share SSO metadata + KMS ARN by Thu 2) Ben to draft infra ticket 3) Ravi to schedule security kickoff w/ Eng Sec.
Priya (AE): noted. Customer concerned about cost for heavy embedding workloads. they asked for an estimate for 200M tokens/mo steady-state + 1B tokens spike.
Lila (CSM): we'll prepare cost scenarios and include Optimize playbook (batching + quantization). Also scheduling weekly sync first 30d.
Ben (CS Ops): infra ticket created: RB-33421. Initial config snippet:
``n
vpc_cidr=10.50.0.0/16
peer_with=northbridge-aws-789
allowed_outbound=[443]
kms_mode=customer-owned
```
Ben (CS Ops): RB-33421 assigned to eng-infra; ETA to start correlation checks: 4 business days.
Ravi (Support Eng): added a monitoring plan and canary route: create on day 2 of pilot, throttle at 50rps for safe ramp.
Lila (CSM): capturing adoption metrics: daily active teams, avg tokens/day, error rate per route. setting targets for pilot: DAU >= 5 teams, latency p95 < 300ms, errors <1%.
Priya (AE): flagged renewal risk: procurement cycle in 9 months; recommend quarterly executive check-ins starting month 2.
Lila (CSM): will add renewal watch flag. feedback capture: short survey at day 10 and NPS ask at day 30. I'll own survey.
Ben (CS Ops): linking onboarding templates: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/vpc-template and runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-onboard.
Ravi (Support Eng): RB-33421 comment: waiting on SSO metadata and KMS ARN. tagging @Priya for follow-up with customer.
Lila (CSM): thanks team. I'll post kickoff agenda and owners board. any blockers?
Priya (AE): none. handing off. :handshake:
